sections.label: Temasek CEO succession reviews
sections.summary: The Temasek Board conducts annual leadership succession reviews, tracks a confidential candidate list, and its CEO choice requires the President's concurrence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Temasek Board conducts annual leadership succession reviews as a matter of good governance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As reported annually since 2004 in the Temasek Review, the Temasek Board has a board committee which reviews and makes recommendations to the Temasek Board on management leadership development and succession planning for key positions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For CEO succession, the Temasek Board reviews and tracks a list of candidates annually.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: These include those from within the company as well as those from outside Temasek, both in Singapore and abroad.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This confidential list of candidates ranges from those who can step in immediately, to younger candidates who could be potential successors beyond the five-year period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The timing and candidate for CEO succession are the purview of the Temasek Board.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As Temasek is a Fifth-Schedule Company under the Singapore Constitution, the CEO's appointment is subject to the concurrence of the President.

sections.label: Questions are Temasek Board matter
sections.summary: The Minister states that all the Member's questions are a matter for the Temasek Board.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The short answer is that all the questions that the Member has asked are really a matter for the Temasek Board.

sections.label: Temasek as commercial entity
sections.summary: The passage states that the important thing to understand is that Temasek operates as a commercial entity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The important thing to understand is that Temasek operates as a commercial entity.
